_doc: Hand edits over the generated level (docs/authored.md). Everything here survives regeneration. Coordinates: level metres, x east, z south.

buildings.note: Harbor Place / Harbormaster on the pier: blue-grey clapboard, white trim, brown shingle hip roof, stands on piles at the pier edge
Bar Harbor Inn: white clapboard, grey shingle hip roofs, long low wings; lidar read it as flat (the wings are), the main block is hip
Harborside Hotel: weathered grey shingle, white trim, four storeys of gables and dormers along West Street; the procedural flat roof is wrong but the massing is right until Assets models it
West Street Hotel: grey shingle, white trim, hip roof, four storeys
Bar Harbor Club: white, long low wings round the pool, grey roof
Stewman's Downtown: white clapboard over the water on piles
harbour shed east of the pier: dark board walls, teal metal roof (roof colour not yet overridable)

patches.note: example (disabled): a smoother, lower-weed patch of shore; set disabled to false and move c to test. c here is near the east shore of Bar Island.

notes: Town pier (Google Earth reference, 16 Oct): a FILLED pier, not piles — a paved parking lot with white bays on top, granite-block seawall faces, the Harbor Place building on piles at its north edge, two long float systems east of it, whale-watch catamarans and the ferry on the floats. The sim's chart draws it from S-57 SLCONS; a 'filled pier' profile (lot at +3 m, seawall, kerb) is wanted in roads/props.
Agamont Park shore west of the pier: pocket sand/cobble beach with a stone seawall and a lawn above; the Shore Path runs along a granite seawall from the Inn eastward.

Downtown roofs from above: mostly charcoal shingle; the commercial blocks on Main/Cottage are flat with pale membrane roofs; walls predominantly white, some grey shingle, red brick on a few Main Street blocks.
